message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a yellow background and a central blue rectangular frame. At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is printed in large capital letters. To its right are a barcode and QR code. Above "TEMPO," text includes "Siapa Buntung Hapus Tagih Kredit Mikro H.82" and "Gerilya Mengubur Pelanggaran HAM Berat H.30."

Inside the blue frame, the title "WASWAS SLOT" is written in white. Below this is a cartoon of a slot machine screen. The screen shows three vertical reels. The first and second reels each display a pink, oval-shaped human face with black hair and a small smile. Above the first face is a red, rounded shape, and below it is a yellow shape. Above the second face is the word "BAR" in yellow. The third reel shows a pair of red cherries with a green leaf at the top and the top portion of a third identical pink face at the bottom.

Beneath the screen, a dark blue box contains small white circles and a paragraph: "Menteri Budi Arie Setiadi terseret beking judi online pegawai Kementerian Komunikasi dan Digital. Ada pesanan pemblokiran situs judi dari bandar kakap. H.68". On the bottom-left edge, vertical text reads "TEMPO.CO/MINGGUAN ISSN: 0126 - 4273".
